text:
sam: Hey — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2102. Changes: header shim (x-rd-tool-caller) for legacy clients, streaming fallback fix, tests + tiny docs update. Need 1 approval and CI green. Hoping to merge tomorrow morning PST. PTAL when you have a sec @elaine @mike

elaine: On it, will skim tests first.

mike: Quick Q — is the header name stable? worried about mobile clients that still set the old header.

sam: Yes, shim accepts both `x-rd-tool-caller` and `x-tool-caller`. Note added to CHANGELOG.md in the second commit.

elaine: Small nit: docstring in client.py could clarify fallback ordering. I'll leave an inline comment.

ci-bot: CI: build started for PR #2102 — linux/py tests running.

dev-bot: Preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/pr-2102

elaine: LGTM modulo CI and my docstring nit.

mike: I can approve once CI is green. Could you add a one-line changelog in release-notes?

sam: Done — added changelog line and fixed docstring. Re-requesting review.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #2102.

mike: Approved :thumbsup: 

elaine: Approved as well, feel free to merge after your morning smoke test.

sam: Thanks everyone — merging tomorrow morning unless anyone objects.
